thread:
deploy-bot: DeployCheck: BLOCKED for release v2026.03.21-rc2 — env parity failure: keystore TTL differs between staging and prod.

deploy-bot: staging: `keystore.ttl=3600` (from overlay), prod: `keystore.ttl=0` (legacy).

tara: noticed this during canary smoke. jobs that expect zero-ttl are failing auth refresh.

ben: tracing manifests 1: a legacy config map in `staging/overrides.yml` still sets `keystore.ttl: 3600`. I didn't realize it survived the refactor.

rach: how quick to hotfix? change window in 25m. If we can't validate in 15m we should roll back.

ops-lead: agree. options: 1) patch staging overlay to match prod and re-run deploycheck; 2) rollback canary to pinned image sha; 3) schedule prod promotion only in change window.

tara: propose patch+pin: set `keystore.ttl=0` and pin `keystoreChart=sha256:fa57a1`. test on canary for 5m, then promote to staging.

ben: applying patch now. command: `helm upgrade svc --set keystore.ttl=0 --set keystoreChart=sha256:fa57a1 --reuse-values`. re-triggering deploycheck.

deploy-bot: DeployCheck re-run: healthchecks ok on canary, keystore resolves ttl=0, smoke tests pass.

ops-lead: promote to staging and hold prod. open ticket INF-430 to remove legacy override and add a unit test in manifest CI to catch TTL drift.

rach: INF-430 created and assigned to eng-infra. final: patch applied, canary/staging unblocked, prod promotion pending change window + manual approval. :thumbsup:
